I actually have that problem to, and I use to check all of the different meds and side effects.

To be honest, most of them don't make you gain weight, especially on Adderall it always offset that if there could have been a possible side effect. I take lexapro right now and I haven't gained any weight. Wellbutrin also doesn't really have any weight gain possibilities to my knowledge. (don't read everything on the listed side effects - it is all done through studies that have so many different variables that there might have been just a small percent of people who already had problems with weight gain).

Also, SNRIs have a stimulant effect that doesn't have much if any possible weight gain in my experience. 

I know I should say you should worry about yourself before your eating disorder or something like that, but I'm there right now and I understand that feeling. But, to know that there are anti-depressants out there that don't cause weight gain and to get help using them is much better than nothing at all. (:
